# artisanvirt_vms (Data Source)

Lists VMs, optionally filtered by cluster or node.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "artisanvirt_vms" "prod" {
  cluster_id = data.artisanvirt_cluster.prod.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cluster_id` (String)
- `node_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `vms` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vms))

<a id="nestedatt--vms"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vms`

Read-Only:

- `autostart` (Boolean)
- `cluster_id` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `firmware` (String) `bios` or `uefi`.
- `gpu_address` (String) Assigned GPU PCI address, if any.
- `id` (String) VM id.
- `last_error` (String)
- `mac_addresses` (List of String) NIC MACs in order.
- `memory_mib` (Number)
- `name` (String) VM name.
- `node_id` (String) Host node.
- `snapshots` (List of String) Snapshot names.
- `state` (String) VM state.
- `tags` (Map of String)
- `uuid` (String) libvirt UUID.
- `vcpus` (Number)
